answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to be a full time actor.
answers.drew: I grew up in the middle of Catalina Island with only ten other houses, surrounded by bison and dirt roads. Through this isolation, tv became my tunnel to the outside world and I would make up stories as I wandered around the island. I’d look over the water on clear nights and see this sparkling city of LA that I dreamed to work in, and knew that was where I was meant to be.
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with people who are excited to tell diverse stories that want to collaborate as writers, performers, or filmmakers. But also: anyone that’s cool and zany and passionate, which I’m sure there are many.
answers.inspiration: Phoebe Waller-Bridge and her mother. Phoebe for showing me I could write and act in my own television shows, and her mother because she once told Phoebe, “You can be whatever you want to be as long as you’re outrageous”. I live by that statement. No matter what I end up doing, I am going to be outrageous: bold, unusual, and startling.
